rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when a person, work, or option makes it onto the shortlist.

example.traditional: 呢個方案入圍咗最後三強。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 jap6 wai4 zo2 zeoi3 hau6 saam1 koeng4

rows.jyutping: lit6 jap6 hau6 syun2 ming4 daan1
rows.note: Use this more formal transitive phrase when explicitly saying that someone or something is placed on the shortlist.

example.english: The judging panel placed this plan on the shortlist.
example.traditional: 評審團將呢份計劃列入候選名單。
example.jyutping: ping4 sam2 tyun4 zoeng1 ne1 fan6 gai3 waak6 lit6 jap6 hau6 syun2 ming4 daan1
